description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Rochester Institute of Technology is hiring an NTID Junior Full Stack Engineer to develop and maintain full-stack software solutions supporting university students, faculty, and staff. The role works across the software development lifecycle, collaborating with internal customers to clarify requirements, deliver applications, and ensure quality.
Junior Full Stack Engineer designing and developing software solutions, gathering user requirements, and verifying quality across assigned projects

Responsibilities:
• Researches, designs, and develops computer and network software or specialized programs
• Analyzes user needs and develops software solutions, applying principles and techniques of computer science, engineering, and mathematical analysis
• Establishes and maintains strategic relationships with internal customers. Collaborates with customers to gather and clarify requirements, deploy programs, and evaluate user feedback
• Develops software verification plans and quality assurance procedures
• Tracks progress on assigned projects to ensure quality deliverables are met according to schedule
• Creates proper documentation and demonstration of solutions by use of flowcharts, charts, diagrams, documents, layouts, and code comments
• Other duties as assigned

Requirements:
• Knowledge of standard development lifecycle (SDLC)
• Knowledge of risk management and mitigation techniques
• Skill in front-end applications using tools such as React, TypeScript, Jest/Enzyme, GatsbyJS, GraphQL, Bootstrap, and Styled Components
• Skill in SQL Server or MySQL databases and Java, Hypertext Preprocessor (PHP), structured Query Language (SQL), and jquery
• Ability to apply principles and techniques of computer science, engineering, and mathematical analysis
• Ability to analyze, design, develop, implement, and maintain web applications, mobile applications, and databases
• Bachelor's degree in related field
• 1 year of relevant experience
• Equivalent combination of experience and education may be considered
• Candidates must be eligible to work in the United States
